loading.title: Checking…
loading.body: Buckspay reads your wallet connection and this phone’s registration on Solana.

unreachable.title: No connection
unreachable.body: Buckspay needs a connection to read this phone’s registration on Solana.

connect.title: Connect wallet
connect.body: Buckspay pays from, and credits to, a wallet you already use. Connecting shares its address and costs nothing.

create-key.title: Secure this phone
create-key.body: A key made in this phone's secure hardware approves your payments. It never leaves the phone.
create-key.line: A key that never leaves it

activate.title: Add money
activate.body: Your funds go into a reserve that backs what you pay. Activating links this phone to your wallet publicly and permanently. Anyone can see the link on Solana, and it can't be undone.
activate.line: Public, permanent link to your wallet

other-wallet.title: Another wallet
other-wallet.body: This phone is permanently linked to the wallet below. Connect that wallet to pay and receive on this phone.
other-wallet.line: This phone belongs to another wallet

shortfall: Your wallet has {{sol}} SOL. Add SOL to it before you activate.
sponsorshipUnavailable: Buckspay can’t pay for activations right now, so your wallet pays the network costs.

confirmingNotice.sent: Sent to Solana. Waiting for confirmation, usually under a minute. You can leave this screen; this can’t be cancelled.
confirmingNotice.unknown: Your wallet may have sent the activation. Waiting until Solana confirms it or it expires, usually under a minute. You can leave this screen.

softwareKeyWarning: This phone keeps its key in software, where malware can reach it more easily than in secure hardware.

unreachable.title: No connection
unreachable.body: Buckspay couldn’t read this phone’s registration. Check your connection.

ready.title: This phone is registered to your wallet

confirming.title: Activating…
confirming.body: Waiting for Solana to confirm it, usually under a minute.

otherWallet.title: Another wallet
otherWallet.body: Connect the wallet this phone is linked to, to pay and receive.

reconnect.title: Reconnect wallet
reconnect.body: This phone is registered. Connect the wallet it is linked to.

setup.title: Set up payments
setup.body: Paying and receiving need a wallet and this phone’s key, registered on Solana.

viewTransaction: View the transaction in the explorer
activatedAnnouncement: This phone is activated and registered to your wallet.
belowMinimumNote: Below that, your wallet pays the network costs.

problem.nothingSent: Nothing was sent and nothing was charged.
problem.notActivated: Nothing was charged and this phone is not activated.
problem.noFundsMoved: No funds moved, and this phone is not activated.
problem.expired: The activation expired before it went through.
problem.stalled: Solana hasn’t confirmed the activation yet. It may still go through; check again in a minute.
problem.payInstead: You can activate now and pay the network costs from your wallet.
problem.addSol: To activate now, add SOL to your wallet and pay from it.
problem.feeChanged: Buckspay’s terms changed while you were looking. Review them and try again. Nothing was sent.

sponsor.unavailable: Buckspay couldn’t pay for this activation.
sponsor.mismatch: Buckspay’s server offered an activation this app didn’t ask for, so your wallet never saw it.
sponsor.unsupported: Your wallet can’t sign an activation that Buckspay pays for.
sponsor.altered: Your wallet changed the activation before signing it, so it wasn’t sent.
sponsor.unsigned: Your wallet couldn’t sign the activation.

step.connect: The wallet couldn’t connect. Nothing was shared and nothing was charged. Try again.
step.create-key: This phone couldn’t create its key. Nothing was charged. Try again.

problem.notRecognized: Your wallet no longer recognizes Buckspay.
problem.connectionDeclined: The wallet declined the connection. Nothing was shared and nothing was charged.
problem.couldNotSend: Your wallet couldn’t send the activation.
problem.noWalletApp: No wallet app on this phone works with Buckspay. Install Phantom or Solflare, then try again.
problem.unreachableConfirm: Can’t reach Solana to check the activation. It may still go through; check again once you’re online.
problem.unreachable: Can’t reach Solana. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was sent.
problem.couldNotCheck: Buckspay couldn’t check this phone. Nothing was sent. Try again.

tx.key: Solana didn’t accept this phone’s key signature.
tx.registered: This phone’s key is already registered on Solana.
tx.insufficient: Your wallet doesn’t have enough SOL for the activation.
tx.compute: The activation ran out of compute on Solana.

problem.lowSol: Your wallet has {{balance}} SOL and activating costs about {{cost}} SOL in network costs. Add SOL to your wallet, then try again. Nothing was sent.
problem.wrongNetwork: This phone’s key is set up for {{configured}}, and this app for {{cluster}}. Nothing was created, sent or charged.
problem.keyNetwork: This phone’s key was created for {{created}}, and this app signs for {{cluster}}. Nothing was sent or charged.

input.amount: Enter an amount to add. Nothing was sent.
input.days: Choose a reserve of {{min}} to {{max}} days. Nothing was sent.
input.balance: Your wallet has {{have}} {{symbol}} and this needs {{need}} {{symbol}}. Add {{symbol}} to your wallet, then try again. Nothing was sent.

faucet.help: Free money for this test network. It has no real value.
faucet.failed: Could not get it. Try again.
